title: Missing Operative
briefing: An undercover operative working for an allied Haven has stopped communicating from a remote Supply-mining operation. The operative's transmitter code has been provided. Travel to the mining operation, determine what happened to the operative, and recover them if possible.

nodes.text: Visitors check in with Reynolds inside.

responses.text: Who is responsible for Gate security?
Your checkpoint procedure is sloppy. Who authorized this?

nodes.text: Same as usual. Reynolds handles anyone who needs more than directions.
Nothing you need to worry about. Reynolds can answer questions.
You can take that up with Reynolds.
Keep your voice down. I can move once the patients are safe or the source is contained. If you clear the yard checkpoint first, I can slip out early.

responses.text: Stay put while we make a route to the Gate.

nodes.text: I don't know what they're doing with the sick people. They keep telling us to stay out of the way.

responses.text: Where do they keep spare supplies?

nodes.text: Help if you're here to help. Don't start opening things you weren't asked to open.

responses.text: Why are these people being kept here?

nodes.text: They've been pushing this equipment harder every week.

responses.text: Who told them to keep running it?
We will take a look. Stay clear of the unstable equipment.

nodes.text: The overseer. He wants more output, whatever the cost. If you are checking the equipment, look at the lab readings too. Just do not tell him I sent you.

observations.text: The transmitter code confirms this is the missing operative.

actions.label: small talk
actions.outcomeText: The worker reveals a concealed entrance beside Holding. The hidden store is now accessible.

actions.label: inquire
actions.outcomeText: The worker reveals a hidden safe room behind the Overseer office. Its concealed door is now visible.
